title: Decision 2.0
description: Classify text or JSON, estimate yes/no probabilities, and score ordered criteria with Decision 2.0. Lux 9B is included and ready to run; five other model sizes are selectable.

input.name: Decision model
input.description: Lux runs without additional storage. Smaller models need Model Store or a network volume. Vega needs its Qwen base plus a larger GPU; see the README before selecting it.

options.label: Vega 27B (included adapter; Qwen base and larger GPU required)

input.name: Model download directory
input.description: Writable directory on an attached network volume for models missing from the image or Model Store. Lux does not use this directory.

input.name: Model download timeout (seconds)
input.description: Maximum time for the first download to network storage.

input.name: Worker startup timeout (seconds)
input.description: Time allowed to prepare and load the model. Use at least 3600 seconds for Vega's first Qwen download.
